deployments_detail.use: Deployed NVIDIA Omniverse digital-twin and AI simulation across global production lines; opened Intelligent Manufacturing Innovation Center with NVIDIA; claims up to 5x capacity gains
Unveiled AI-sensing collaborative robots with digital-twin production lines and smart warehouse logistics at automation expo

AI digital twin for building automation at Delta's Taipei headquarters, built on NVIDIA Omniverse; integrates lighting, sunlight/heat, HVAC, environmental sensors and building controls with photorealistic simulation for real-time optimization, predictive analytics and autonomous building/maintenance functions. [NVIDIA Omniverse (Delta DIATwin)]

DIATwin AI digital twin deployed for smart manufacturing of AI server power supplies at Delta's Thailand facility; integrates product design, equipment, robotics and process data into a high-fidelity digital twin, using NVIDIA PhysX for line simulation, NVIDIA Cosmos for anomaly detection, OpenUSD modeling, and synthetic-defect generation to train AOI inspection. [Delta DIATwin on NVIDIA Omniverse (PhysX, Cosmos)]

DIATwin + RTM digital twin platform used to accelerate new product introduction (e.g. glue-dispensing path simulation and virtual machine commissioning) for a major electronics assembly manufacturer in Taiwan, replacing physical prototyping with 3D simulation. [Delta DIATwin + RTM]
deployments_detail.value: machine commissioning time reduced by over 80%

deployments_detail.use: Smart Manufacturing Innovation Center at Delta's Zhongli Plant 6 (Taiwan): a ~500 m2 operational facility with a 3D real-time equipment-monitoring dashboard, digital-twin/AI-model validation zones, and a Delta & NVIDIA Cyber-Physical Integration Classroom, used to validate equipment and train AI-based manufacturing before line deployment. [Delta DIATwin / Line Manager, NVIDIA Omniverse]

Smart upgrade of an inverter production line at Taoyuan Plant 1 using AR/Mixed Reality (Microsoft HoloLens) to virtualize equipment information and automate pick-list downloads and picking workflows, delivered with Microsoft, PTC and Far EasTone. [Microsoft (HoloLens/Azure), PTC, Far EasTone]

AI-based Six-Sided Inspection Machine that combines patented automated optical inspection (AOI) with AI/machine vision to detect minor defects on small electronic components (down to 0.4 x 0.2 mm) that conventional AOI cannot catch, to raise yield and lower reject rates. [Delta (AOI + AI machine vision)]

AI-based automation and digital twins for semiconductor manufacturing (with subsidiary Universal Instruments), including a Wafer Edge Profile Measurement Machine using non-destructive AOI to inspect wafer notches/edges/chamfers, plus DIATwin virtual-machine development generating synthetic training data for inspection models. [Delta DIATwin on NVIDIA Omniverse; Universal Instruments]

AI-Enabled Cognitive Cobot: Delta D-Bot collaborative robot series with an AI Cognitive Module enabling voice-command recognition, dynamic-environment adaptation and real-time path adjustment for pick-and-place; developed/validated with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, cuMotion motion planning and PhysX in a cyber-physical demo line. [Delta D-Bot; NVIDIA Isaac Sim, cuMotion, PhysX]

DeltaGrid energy management platform using AI and IoT-based analytics to monitor, predict and optimize energy usage and balance power loads, with AI-driven optimization and predictive maintenance for energy storage / building energy systems. [Delta DeltaGrid (AI + IoT analytics)]
